title: isTrackerBlockedOnDaniel
responsibility: Decide from an unflagged blocked reason whether the next action is one only Daniel can take.

inputs.name: isTrackerBlockedOnDaniel.reason
inputs.description: Blocked reason text. Past approvals, later steps and statements that nothing is needed do not count.

outputs.name: isTrackerBlockedOnDaniel
outputs.description: True when the reason says the next action is one only Daniel can take.
